### Sensitivity Analysis: Sepsis-free Survival

X-hour time window for patients with the outcome
Negative patients: full hospitalization
Positive patients: only those predictions X hours before sepsis onset
```{r}
patient.data.Xh <- patient.data |> 
  group_by(LCSN) |> 
  filter(sep3.outcome==0 | (sep3.outcome==1 & time.point >= max.time.point - time_horizon*4))
```

Aggregate data
```{r}
aggregated.data <- aggregate(patient.data.Xh, list(patient.data.Xh$LCSN), max)
```

```{r}
measures_fp_tp <- function(predictions=NULL, labels=NULL, N.measures=200, min.pred=0){
  # initialize cutoff values
  cutoffs <- seq(1, min.pred, length.out = N.measures)
  
  # calculate TP and FP
  TP <- c()
  FP <- c()
  
  for (cutoff in cutoffs) {
    TP <- c(TP, sum(predictions >= cutoff & labels == 1))
    FP <- c(FP, sum(predictions >= cutoff & labels == 0))
  }
  
  return(list(
    cutoffs = cutoffs,
    TP = TP,
    FP = FP
  ))
}
```
```

Obtain results for 4 different thresholds
```{r}
final.thresholds <- c(20, 25, 30)

for (final.threshold in final.thresholds) {
  
  # Calculate TP and FP across cutoffs
  results <- measures_fp_tp(
    predictions = aggregated.data$model.score,
    labels = aggregated.data$sep3.outcome,
    min.pred = 0
  )
  
  # Find the cutoff corresponding to the desired threshold
  threshold <- final.threshold / 100
  i <- which.min(abs(results$cutoffs - threshold))
  
  # Extract TP and FP at this threshold
  TP <- results$TP[i]
  FP <- results$FP[i]
  
  cat(
    "Threshold:", final.threshold, 
    "% | TP:", TP, 
    "| FP:", FP, "\n"
  )
}
```
